senses.title: A place where someone lives or stays
senses.definition: a room, flat, or house where someone lives or stays for a period of time
senses.definitionCN: 供人居住或停留一段时间的房间、公寓或房屋
senses.example: The price includes accommodation and two meals a day.
senses.exampleCN: 这个价格包含住处和每日两餐。
senses.why: The word first meant the act of fitting something in; a place that fits a person's need to sleep becomes a place to stay.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指把东西安放合适；一个能安放睡眠需求的地方，就成了住处。

senses.title: Lodging supplied for payment
senses.definition: rooms provided for travellers or students in exchange for money
senses.definitionCN: 向旅客或学生收取费用而提供的房间
senses.example: Hotel accommodation in the old town is scarce in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 夏天老城区的酒店住宿很紧张。
senses.why: In British usage the noun is usually uncountable, so it names the service rather than one particular room.
senses.whyCN: 在英式用法里这个名词通常不可数，因此它指的是服务，而不是某一个房间。

senses.title: The act of adjusting to fit
senses.definition: the process of changing something so that it suits a new person, need, or situation
senses.definitionCN: 改变某物，使它适合新的人、新的需要或新的情况的过程
senses.example: The school made an accommodation for students who cannot walk upstairs.
senses.exampleCN: 学校为不能上楼的学生做了调整。
senses.why: The core image is physical: furniture is moved so that what did not fit now fits.
senses.whyCN: 核心画面是实体动作：把家具挪一挪，原本放不下的就放得下了。

senses.title: A settlement between opposing sides
senses.definition: an agreement in which two sides accept a compromise instead of continuing a dispute
senses.definitionCN: 双方接受妥协、不再继续争执的协议
senses.example: The two parties reached an accommodation over the use of the river.
senses.exampleCN: 双方就河流的使用达成了和解。
senses.why: To accommodate an opponent is to make room for their position, and a settlement is exactly that in speech.
senses.whyCN: 迁就对手就是给对方的立场腾出位置，而和解正是言语上的这一步。

senses.title: A helpful favour or convenience
senses.definition: something done to help someone or make a situation easier, often as a personal favour
senses.definitionCN: 为帮助某人或让局面更容易而做的事，常属私人情面
senses.example: Could you do me an accommodation and let me hand in the essay tomorrow?
senses.exampleCN: 能不能通融一下，让我明天交那篇论文？
senses.why: Making room for a person's difficulty is the same gesture as moving furniture aside.
senses.whyCN: 为一个人的难处腾出位置，与把家具挪开是同一个动作。

intro.en: Accommodation is built from Latin parts that all point at fitness: a prefix meaning toward, a base meaning convenient, and a suffix naming an act.
intro.cn: accommodation 由几个拉丁构件拼成，全都指向「合宜」：一个表示「朝向」的前缀、一个意为「合宜」的词基，以及一个表示行为的后缀。

items.en: In modern English the dominant sense is lodging, and the uncountable British use sits beside the countable American plural.
items.cn: 在现代英语里，最主要的意思是住宿；英式不可数用法与美式复数用法并立。

items.en: English borrowed the noun in the sixteenth century for the act of adapting or fitting something.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入这个名词，当时指使某物适应、合宜的行为。

items.en: French accommodation carried the same legal and practical sense of adjusting a thing to a purpose.
items.cn: 法语 accommodation 同样带着法律与实务意味，指让事物合乎某个用途。

items.en: Accommodare meant to fit one thing to another; it joined the prefix ad with the verb commodare.
items.cn: accommodare 意为使一物适合另一物；它把前缀 ad 与动词 commodare 连接起来。

items.en: Commodus meant convenient or suitable, and from it came commodum, a convenience or advantage.
items.cn: commodus 意为合宜、合适，由它产生了 commodum，指便利或好处。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on the same Latin base; the near-meaning group gathers words for a place to stay.
note.cn: 形近组收同一个拉丁词基长出的各形；近义组收表示住处、栖身之所的词。

entries.definition: To provide someone with a place to stay, or to adjust something to fit.

entries.definition: Willing to help or adjust to other people's wishes.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「乐于助人的、随和的」。

entries.definition: Roomy and comfortable, literally full of convenience.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「宽敞舒适的」，字面即「充满便利」。

entries.definition: A useful thing that can be bought and sold.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「商品、有用之物」，与便利这一词根同源。

entries.definition: A place where one sleeps for a short stay, often paid for.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「寄宿处、临时住所」，多指付费短住。

entries.definition: Buildings provided for people to live in, seen as a collective supply.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「住房」，指作为整体的居住建筑供给。

entries.definition: Rooms assigned to a person or group, especially in the forces.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「营房、住处」，尤指分配给个人或团体的房间。

entries.definition: A place that protects someone from weather or danger.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「庇护所、栖身处」，指遮风避雨或避险之地。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the double letters and the Latin base that the word really has.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子用的是这个词真实存在的双写字母与拉丁词基。

normal.en: Break it as ad plus commoda plus tion, and the Latin base commodus tells you it is about making things convenient.
normal.cn: 拆成 ad 加 commoda 加 tion；拉丁词基 commodus 意为合宜，说明这个词讲的是把事情办得合宜。

normal.en: Accommodate carries two c letters and two m letters, and the noun keeps both pairs.
normal.cn: accommodate 有两个 c 和两个 m，名词形式把这两对都保留下来。

normal.en: The verb came first and the noun followed, so to accommodate a guest is to find that guest room.
normal.cn: 先有动词，后有名词；给客人找到房间，就是 accommodate 一位客人。

normal.en: British hotel advertisements say self-catering accommodation, and there the noun covers a whole flat.
normal.cn: 英国的酒店广告会写 self-catering accommodation，这时这个名词涵盖整套公寓。

normal.en: Remember the two c letters, two m letters and two o letters; the word is as roomy as the space it names.
normal.cn: 记住两个 c、两个 m 和两个 o；这个词的拼写就像它所指的容身空间一样宽松。

abstract.en: Picture a tiny room where only a bed fits, until the landlord moves one cabinet and the bed drops into place.
abstract.cn: 想象一间小屋只放得下一张床，房东挪开一个柜子，床就刚好落进空位。

abstract.en: At a long table two sides pull their chairs back, and the corridor between them is the settlement.
abstract.cn: 长桌两端的人各自把椅子往后拉开，中间让出的那条过道就是和解。

abstract.en: Pull the lens of an eye like a piece of furniture and you have the medical sense of the same word.
abstract.cn: 把眼内晶状体当成一件家具挪动，你就得到了这个词的医学义。

examples.en: The university guarantees accommodation to all first-year students.
examples.cn: 这所大学保证为所有一年级学生提供住处。

examples.en: They reached an accommodation after three days of talks.
examples.cn: 经过三天会谈，他们达成了和解。

examples.en: The lens changes shape as part of the eye's accommodation.
examples.cn: 晶状体改变形状，是眼睛调节作用的一部分。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额靠摸得神」——摸到一张床，便有了容身之处

root: 拉丁语 accommodare「使适合」，由 ad-「朝向」加 commodare「使便利」构成，后者出自 commodus「合宜的」；十六世纪进入英语，先指「适应、调节」，十九世纪起大量指「住处、住宿」。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses cover a place to stay, paid lodging, an adjustment, a settlement of differences, and a small favour.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项覆盖住处、付费住宿、调整适应、分歧的和解，以及一点通融。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: furniture is shifted aside so that what did not fit now fits.
core.cn: 核心意象：把家具挪到一边，原本放不下的东西就放得下了。

branches.en: THE HOME: a place where one stays.
branches.cn: 住处线：人停留的地方。

branches.en: THE PAID BED: lodging bought for a night.
branches.cn: 付费线：花钱买一夜的住处。

branches.en: THE ADJUSTMENT: the eye or a system changes to fit.
branches.cn: 调整线：眼睛或系统作出适应。

branches.en: THE SETTLEMENT: two sides reach terms.
branches.cn: 和解线：双方达成条件。

branches.en: THE FAVOUR: a small exception is granted.
branches.cn: 通融线：给予一点例外的方便。

intro.en: The word is built from a Latin prefix, two Latin bases, and two familiar endings, so its parts can be read as one small family.
intro.cn: 这个词由一个拉丁前缀、两个拉丁词基和两个常见词尾构成，各部分可以当作一个小家族来读。

latinIntro.en: Latin accommodare, commodus, and commodum are recorded in classical texts; commodare is the verb derived from commodus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 accommodare、commodus 与 commodum 在古典文献中均有记载；commodare 是由 commodus 派生的动词。

items.example: It points the action of fitting toward a goal.
items.exampleCN: 它把「使适合」这个动作指向某个目标。

items.example: It supplies the idea of convenience inside the word.
items.exampleCN: 它为这个词提供了「便利」这层含义。

items.example: It turns the adjective into an action of fitting.
items.exampleCN: 它把这个形容词变成了「使合宜」的动作。

items.example: It is the direct source of the English verb.
items.exampleCN: 它是英语动词的直接来源。

items.example: It forms the noun accommodation from the verb.
items.exampleCN: 它把动词构成名词 accommodation。

items.example: It entered English before the noun.
items.exampleCN: 它比名词更早进入英语。

items.example: It describes a person who makes room for others.
items.exampleCN: 它形容愿意为别人腾出位置的人。

items.example: It is the headword of this entry.
items.exampleCN: 它是本词条的目标词。

items.example: American usage prefers the plural for rooms.
items.exampleCN: 美式用法谈到房间时多用复数。

latinEntries.meaning: to fit one thing to another

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁动词直接借入，义为「提供住处；使适应」
由动词加 -ing 转作形容词，义为「随和的；肯通融的」
由本词加 -ive 构成，义为「有调节作用的」

definition_zh: 陪伴；陪同；伴随；伴奏；附加
definition_en: to go somewhere with someone, to happen at the same time as something, or to play music for a singer
core_image: 一个人走在旁边，与另一个人同进同出
scene: 机场登机口前，一位老人走得很慢，小男孩把她的包挎在肩上，紧挨着她。The officer said the child must be accompanied by an adult.
sceneCN: 这里 accompanied 指由成年人陪同（第 1 个义项：陪伴同行）；句意为工作人员说孩子必须由成人陪同。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ment 构成，义为「陪伴物；伴奏」
由本词加 -ist 构成，义为「伴奏者」
由现在分词转作形容词，义为「随同的；附带的」

senses.title: To go somewhere together with someone
senses.definition: to travel or walk with a person so that they are not alone
senses.definitionCN: 与人一同行走或出行，使对方不孤单
senses.example: Her brother accompanied her to the station.
senses.exampleCN: 她哥哥陪她去了车站。
senses.why: The Old French source means to be a companion, and the picture is two people sharing one road.
senses.whyCN: 古法语的来源词意为「与人作伴」，画面是两个人共用一条路。

senses.title: To escort someone under supervision
senses.definition: to go with a person in order to guard or control their movement
senses.definitionCN: 与人同行，以便看守或控制其行动
senses.example: Two officers accompanied the witness from the court.
senses.exampleCN: 两名警官把证人从法庭送了出来。
senses.why: Being beside a person can be a duty rather than a kindness, and the word covers both.
senses.whyCN: 走在一个人身边，可以是善意，也可以是职务；这个词两种情形都包得住。

senses.title: To happen at the same time
senses.definition: to occur together with something else, especially as a usual pairing
senses.definitionCN: 与另一件事同时出现，尤其指常见的搭配
senses.example: Heavy rain accompanied the strong winds that night.
senses.exampleCN: 那天夜里，大风伴随着暴雨。
senses.why: Two events walking side by side is the same picture transferred from people to happenings.
senses.whyCN: 两件事并肩而行，就是把人和人的画面挪用到事件上。

senses.title: To play music for a singer
senses.definition: to play an instrument while another person sings or performs, supporting them
senses.definitionCN: 在他人演唱或表演时演奏乐器，为其衬托
senses.example: A string quartet accompanied the soloist.
senses.exampleCN: 一支弦乐四重奏为独唱者伴奏。
senses.why: The musician walks beside the melody without leading it, which is companionship in sound.
senses.whyCN: 乐手走在旋律旁边而不领着它，这就是声音里的陪伴。

senses.title: To attach something to a document
senses.definition: to send a paper, letter, or note together with another document
senses.definitionCN: 把文件、信件或说明与另一份文件一并送出
senses.example: Please accompany the form with a copy of your passport.
senses.exampleCN: 请随表格附上护照复印件。
senses.why: One document goes with another just as one person goes with a friend.
senses.whyCN: 一份文件跟着另一份走，正像一个人跟着朋友走。

intro.en: Accompany reaches back to a Latin word for someone who shares bread, and its oldest sense is simply being a companion.
intro.cn: accompany 可上溯到拉丁语里表示「分食面包的人」的词，最古老的意义就是作伴。

items.en: Modern usage adds the musical sense and the medical sense, both built on the idea of going along with something.
items.cn: 现代用法增添了音乐义与医学义，两者都建立在「随之而行」的观念上。

items.en: English took the verb in the fourteenth century with the sense of joining someone on a journey.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入这个动词，指与人在旅途上同行。

items.en: Acompaignier meant to be a companion to someone, formed from the noun compaign.
items.cn: acompaignier 意为给人作伴，由名词 compaign 加前缀构成。

items.en: Companio named a person who shares bread with another, from com meaning with and panis meaning bread.
items.cn: companio 指与他人分食面包的人，由 com「共同」与 panis「面包」组合而成。

items.en: Panis, the ordinary Latin word for bread, is the same root behind company and companion.
items.cn: panis 是拉丁语里表示面包的普通词，也是 company 与 companion 的共同词根。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same bread-sharing family; the near-meaning group gathers verbs for going along with a person.
note.cn: 形近组收同一个「分食面包」家族里的词；近义组收表示与人同行的动词。

entries.definition: The state of being with others, or a business firm.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「陪伴、同伴」或「公司」，与本词同源。

entries.definition: A person who spends time with another.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「同伴、伴侣」，与本词同源。

entries.definition: The feeling of having someone with you.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「陪伴、情谊」。

entries.definition: A musician who plays for a singer or soloist.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「伴奏者」。

entries.definition: To go with someone, often for protection or guidance.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「护送、陪同」，多含保护或引导之意。

entries.definition: To go with someone as a servant or helper in older usage.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「随侍、陪同」，属较旧的正式用法。

entries.definition: To stay with a young person in public to keep them safe.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「陪同监护」，指在公开场合照看年轻人。

entries.definition: To travel with ships or vehicles as a guard.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「护航、护送」，指随船队或车队同行护卫。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the bread-sharing origin and the forms the verb really takes.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子用的是「分食面包」的来源，以及这个动词真实的变化形式。

normal.en: The last three letters are any, and a companion is anyone who shares the road with you.
normal.cn: 词尾三个字母是 any，而同伴就是任何一个与你共走一段路的人。

normal.en: Accompany hides company and companion inside it, because all three go back to one who shares bread.
normal.cn: accompany 里藏着 company 与 companion，三者都追溯到「分食面包的人」。

normal.en: The past tense doubles nothing but changes y to i: accompanied, not accompaned.
normal.cn: 过去式不需要双写，只把 y 变 i：写 accompanied，而不是 accompaned。

normal.en: The passive frame be accompanied by is the standard way to say that something comes along with something else.
normal.cn: 被动结构 be accompanied by 是表示「某物伴随某物」的标准说法。

normal.en: Keep the musical pair together: the accompanist plays, the accompaniment is the part played.
normal.cn: 把音乐这一对记在一起：accompanist 是演奏的人，accompaniment 是被奏出的部分。

abstract.en: See two shadows on one road, one slightly behind the other but never leaving.
abstract.cn: 想象一条路上有两道影子，一道略在后面，却始终没有离开。

abstract.en: A single violin line runs beside a voice without ever overtaking it.
abstract.cn: 一条小提琴的旋律贴着人声走，从不越过它。

abstract.en: A page of paper travels inside an envelope: the letter accompanies the form.
abstract.cn: 一页纸塞进信封里随行：信笺陪伴着表格。

examples.en: A nurse accompanied the patient to the operating theatre.
examples.cn: 一名护士陪病人去了手术室。

examples.en: Thunder usually accompanies a heavy summer storm.
examples.cn: 夏天的暴雨通常伴有雷声。

examples.en: He asked her to accompany him on the violin.
examples.cn: 他请她用小提琴为他伴奏。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿康陪你」——阿康总在旁边陪着你走

root: 古法语 acompaignier「与人作伴」，源自名词 compaign「同伴」，更早是晚期拉丁语 companio，由 com-「共同」加 panis「面包」构成，本义「分食面包的人」；十四世纪进入英语，先指旅途同行。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses go along with someone, guard them, happen at the same time, play music with them, and attach a document.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项都是「跟着、陪着」：陪同某人、护送某人、同时发生、为其伴奏，以及随附文件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one figure walks beside another and does not leave.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个身影走在另一个身影旁边，始终不离开。

branches.en: THE COMPANY: one person goes with another.
branches.cn: 同行线：一个人与另一个人一起走。

branches.en: THE ESCORT: the going along becomes protection.
branches.cn: 护送线：同行变成护卫。

branches.en: THE TIMING: two events occur together.
branches.cn: 同时线：两件事一起发生。

branches.en: THE MUSIC: an instrument follows a voice.
branches.cn: 音乐线：乐器跟着人声。

branches.en: THE DOCUMENT: a paper travels with another.
branches.cn: 附随线：一份文件随另一份同行。

intro.en: The word is a French verb built on a Latin compound noun, so its parts are a prefix, a noun, and English endings.
intro.cn: 这个词是由拉丁复合名词长出的法语动词，因此它的构件是一个前缀、一个名词和几个英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin companio and Latin panis are both attested; the French verb acompaignier is recorded from the twelfth century.
latinIntro.cn: 晚期拉丁语 companio 与拉丁语 panis 均有文献可证；法语动词 acompaignier 自十二世纪起有记录。

items.example: It marks the sharing that the whole word depends on.
items.exampleCN: 它标出了整词赖以成立的「共享」。

items.example: Bread shared is the oldest image of companionship.
items.exampleCN: 共享的面包是「陪伴」最古老的意象。

items.example: It became the French word for a companion.
items.exampleCN: 它演变成法语里表示同伴的词。

items.example: It supplied the noun behind the English verb.
items.exampleCN: 它为英语动词提供了背后的名词。

items.example: It is the direct source of accompany.
items.exampleCN: 它是 accompany 的直接来源。

items.example: It entered English in the fourteenth century.
items.exampleCN: 它在十四世纪进入英语。

items.example: It forms accompaniment.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accompaniment。

items.example: It forms accompanist.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accompanist。

items.example: It forms accompanying.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accompanying。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ment 构成，义为「伴奏；伴随物」
由本词加 -ist 构成，义为「伴奏者」
由现在分词转作形容词，义为「随同的；附带的」

definition_zh: 完成；达成；实现；履行；走完
definition_en: to finish something successfully, especially a task, aim, or duty that takes effort
core_image: 一件铺开的事情被一点点填满，直到最后不再有空缺
scene: 黎明时分的山脊上，登山者终于站到最后一个岩石突出处，风把她的外套吹得作响。After two failed climbs she had accomplished what she once thought impossible.
sceneCN: 这里 accomplished 指做成了曾以为做不到的事（第 1 个义项：完成任务）；句意为在两次失败之后她终于完成。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ment 构成，义为「成就；完成」
由过去分词转作形容词，义为「技艺精湛的；成就卓著的」
由动词加 -able 构成，义为「可完成的」

senses.title: To finish a task that has been started
senses.definition: to bring a piece of work to its end, so that nothing remains to be done
senses.definitionCN: 把一件已经开始的工作做到终点，不再剩下未做之处
senses.example: They accomplished the repairs before the storm arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在暴风雨来临之前完成了修缮。
senses.why: The Latin base means to fill up, and a finished task is a container with no empty space left.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词基意为「填满」，完成的任务就像一只不再有空隙的容器。

senses.title: To reach an aim one has set
senses.definition: to succeed in reaching a goal that was planned in advance
senses.definitionCN: 成功抵达事先设定的目标
senses.example: The team accomplished its goal of cutting waste by half.
senses.exampleCN: 团队达成了把浪费减半的目标。
senses.why: A goal is a far edge; filling the distance between here and there is the same action.
senses.whyCN: 目标是一道远方的边界；把此处到那里的距离填满，是同一个动作。

senses.title: To carry out a duty or role
senses.definition: to perform what an office, promise, or role requires of you
senses.definitionCN: 履行职务、承诺或角色所要求的职责
senses.example: She accomplished her duties as chair without complaint.
senses.exampleCN: 她毫无怨言地履行了主席的职责。
senses.why: A duty is a defined space of obligation, and accomplishing it leaves that space complete.
senses.whyCN: 职责是一块被划定出来的义务空间，完成职责就是把这块空间填满。

senses.title: To produce a result worth noting
senses.definition: to achieve something that others recognise as a real result
senses.definitionCN: 取得被他人认可为实际成果的东西
senses.example: In one season he accomplished more than his predecessor in five years.
senses.exampleCN: 他一个季度做出的成果，超过前任五年的积累。
senses.why: Here the emphasis moves from finishing to the weight of what was finished.
senses.whyCN: 这里的重点从「做完」移到「做成的东西有多重」。

intro.en: Accomplish comes from a Latin verb meaning to fill up, and every sense still carries that image of a space closed.
intro.cn: accomplish 来自一个意为「填满」的拉丁动词，每个义项都还带着「空间被合拢」的画面。

items.en: The adjective accomplished now usually praises skill, while the verb keeps the sense of finishing work.
items.cn: 如今形容词 accomplished 多用于称赞技艺，而动词仍保留「把事做完」的意思。

items.en: English borrowed the verb in the fourteenth century for completing a task or a journey.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入这个动词，指完成任务或走完旅程。

items.en: Acomplir meant to fulfil or complete, and it kept the Latin image of filling something full.
items.cn: acomplir 意为履行、完成，保留了拉丁语「把东西填满」的意象。

items.en: The Latin verb complere meant to fill up; with the prefix ad it meant to fill something to its end.
items.cn: 拉丁动词 complere 意为填满；加上前缀 ad 后，指把某物填到尽头。

items.en: The root plere, to fill, also survives in complete, supplement, and plenty.
items.cn: 词根 plere 意为填充，也残存在 complete、supplement 与 plenty 之中。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms on the same filling root; the near-meaning group gathers verbs for reaching a result.
note.cn: 形近组收同一个「填满」词根长出的词；近义组收表示达成结果的动词。

entries.definition: A finished piece of work or a skill gained.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「成就、完成的事」。

entries.definition: Highly skilled and polished through practice.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「技艺精湛的、有造诣的」。

entries.definition: Whole, with no part missing; from the same filling root.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「完整的」，同出「填满」这一词根。

entries.definition: Something that fills out or completes another thing.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「补足物」，指把另一物补全的东西。

entries.definition: To reach a result through effort, especially a goal.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「达成、取得」，强调经过努力获得结果。

entries.definition: To reach something desired, often after a long climb.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「达到、获得」，语气正式，多含长期攀登之意。

entries.definition: To carry out a promise, duty, or need completely.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「履行、实现」，指把承诺、职责或需要做足。

entries.definition: To carry out an activity or piece of work.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「进行、实施」，指开展某项活动或工作。

normalIntro.en: These hooks break the word at its real Latin seam and pair it with the words it actually follows.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子在这个词真实的拉丁接缝处拆开，并配上它实际搭配的词。

normal.en: Break it as ad plus compl plus ish: complere fills a space, and the prefix aims that filling at one end.
normal.cn: 拆成 ad 加 compl 加 ish：complere 是把空间填满，前缀把这份填充指向一个终点。

normal.en: The same root sits inside complete and supplement, so all three words speak of a whole with no gap.
normal.cn: 同一个词根藏在 complete 与 supplement 里，三个词说的都是没有缺口的整体。

normal.en: The verb does not double its last consonant: accomplished, accomplishing.
normal.cn: 这个动词结尾不双写辅音：写 accomplished、accomplishing。

normal.en: Accomplish a task, accomplish a goal, accomplish a mission: the object is always a bounded piece of work.
normal.cn: accomplish a task、accomplish a goal、accomplish a mission，宾语总是一件有边界的活儿。

normal.en: Accomplishment is the finished thing, accomplished is the finished person.
normal.cn: accomplishment 是做完的事，accomplished 是做完的人。

abstract.en: See a shallow bowl being filled grain by grain until the surface is level and nothing more fits.
abstract.cn: 想象一只浅碗被一粒一粒填满，直到表面齐平、再也装不下。

abstract.en: A road drawn on a map is filled in from the first town to the last.
abstract.cn: 地图上的一条路，从第一座城一路涂到最后一座城。

abstract.en: A duty is an outline, and finishing it colours the whole outline in.
abstract.cn: 职责是一个轮廓，做完它就把整个轮廓涂满了。

examples.en: She accomplished the whole report in a single night.
examples.cn: 她用一个晚上完成了整份报告。

examples.en: The mission was accomplished without a single casualty.
examples.cn: 这项任务在没有任何伤亡的情况下完成了。

examples.en: He is an accomplished pianist as well as a surgeon.
examples.cn: 他既是外科医生，也是一位造诣很深的钢琴家。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额扛不累兮」——扛着活儿一路填满，做完就不累了

root: 古法语 acomplir「完成、履行」，源自拉丁语 ad-「朝向」加 complere「填满」，后者出自 plere「填充」；十四世纪进入英语，最初指把任务或旅程做到终点。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses finish a task, reach a goal, discharge a duty, and produce a result.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项分别是完成任务、达到目标、履行职责，以及做出成果。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a space is filled grain by grain until nothing more fits.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个空间被一点点填满，直到再也装不下。

branches.en: THE TASK: work is carried to its end.
branches.cn: 任务线：工作被做到尽头。

branches.en: THE GOAL: a target is reached.
branches.cn: 目标线：靶子被够到。

branches.en: THE DUTY: an obligation is discharged.
branches.cn: 职责线：义务被履行。

branches.en: THE RESULT: something is produced that can be shown.
branches.cn: 成果线：做出可以拿出来的东西。

branches.en: THE COMPLETION: a finished task and a reached goal are one line's two ends.
branches.cn: 完成线：做完的任务与够到的目标，是同一条线的两端。

intro.en: The word combines a Latin prefix, a Latin verb of filling, and a French verb ending that English kept.
intro.cn: 这个词由一个拉丁前缀、一个表示填充的拉丁动词，以及一个英语保留下来的法语动词词尾组成。

latinIntro.en: Latin complere and plere are well attested; the French form acomplir is recorded from the twelfth century.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 complere 与 plere 均有充分文献可证；法语形式 acomplir 自十二世纪起有记录。

items.example: It directs the filling toward a finishing point.
items.exampleCN: 它把填充这个动作指向一个终点。

items.example: It is the deepest root of the word.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个词最深的词根。

items.example: It gives the word its sense of a closed space.
items.exampleCN: 它为这个词提供了「空间合拢」的含义。

items.example: It is the direct source of the English verb.
items.exampleCN: 它是英语动词的直接来源。

items.example: It entered English in the fourteenth century.
items.exampleCN: 它在十四世纪进入英语。

items.example: It forms accomplishment.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accomplishment。

items.example: It forms accomplished.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accomplished。

items.example: It forms accomplishable.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accomplishable。

items.example: It forms accomplishing.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accomplishing。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ment 构成，义为「成就；完成」
由过去分词转作形容词，义为「有造诣的；娴熟的」
由动词加 -able 构成，义为「可完成的」

definition_zh: 协议；一致；给予；授予；和音
definition_en: a formal agreement, or to give something such as praise, permission, or a right to someone
core_image: 两颗心被摆到同一个位置上，于是彼此合上了拍
scene: 两方代表在长桌两侧坐了很久，最后各自把文件推回桌子中间，签下同一个名字。After weeks of argument the two sides finally reached an accord.
sceneCN: 这里 accord 指双方达成的协议（第 1 个义项：协议）；句意为争论数周之后，两方终于达成协议。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ance 构成，义为「一致；符合」
由 according 加 -ly 构成，义为「因此；相应地」
由本词加 -ant 构成，义为「一致的；协调的」

senses.title: A formal agreement between parties
senses.definition: an official arrangement that two or more sides accept and agree to follow
senses.definitionCN: 双方或多方接受并同意遵守的正式安排
senses.example: The two countries signed a trade accord in March.
senses.exampleCN: 两国在三月签署了一项贸易协议。
senses.why: The Latin root means heart, and an agreement is literally a bringing of hearts into one place.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「心」，而达成协议就是把两颗心放到同一个地方。

senses.title: The state of being in agreement
senses.definition: a condition in which things or people do not conflict with one another
senses.definitionCN: 事物或人彼此不冲突的状态
senses.example: Their account is in accord with the written record.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的说法与书面记录一致。
senses.why: The noun names the settled position of two hearts that no longer pull apart.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指两颗心不再互相拉扯之后所处的位置。

senses.title: To give praise, permission, or attention
senses.definition: to grant a person something abstract, such as respect, a welcome, or a privilege
senses.definitionCN: 把尊重、欢迎或特权这类抽象之物给予某人
senses.example: The committee accorded her the respect she deserved.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会给予了她应得的尊重。
senses.why: To give is to place something in another's hands, and the word pictures that handing over.
senses.whyCN: 给予就是把东西放到别人手里，这个词画的正是递交的动作。

senses.title: To match or correspond with something
senses.definition: to be consistent with another fact, rule, or description
senses.definitionCN: 与另一项事实、规则或描述保持一致
senses.example: His actions do not accord with his promises.
senses.exampleCN: 他的行动与他的承诺并不相符。
senses.why: Two lines that run together without crossing are the visual form of correspondence.
senses.whyCN: 两条线并行而不交叉，就是「相符」的视觉形态。

intro.en: Accord goes back to a Latin phrase about the heart, and its oldest sense is two parties being brought into one mind.
intro.cn: accord 上溯到一个关于「心」的拉丁说法，最古老的意义是让双方进入同一种心思。

items.en: The noun now names treaties and harmonies, while the verb keeps the formal sense of granting something.
items.cn: 如今名词指条约与和音，动词则保留「正式给予」这一含义。

items.en: English took the word early, at first as a verb meaning to reconcile or bring to agreement.
items.cn: 英语很早借入这个词，最初是动词，意为「使和解、使达成一致」。

items.en: Acorder meant to bring people to one mind, and it was used for treaties and for tuning strings.
items.cn: acorder 意为使人同心，既用于条约，也用于给琴弦调音。

items.en: The phrase ad cor meant to the heart, and the compound carried the idea of placing hearts side by side.
items.cn: 短语 ad cor 意为「向着心」，这个复合词带着把心并排放置的意思。

items.en: Cor, the Latin word for heart, is also behind cordial, concord, and discord.
items.cn: cor 是拉丁语里表示心的词，也藏在 cordial、concord 与 discord 之中。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on the same heart root; the near-meaning group gathers words for settled agreements.
note.cn: 形近组收同一个「心」词根长出的词；近义组收表示定下来的协议之类的词。

entries.definition: The state of agreeing with a rule or statement.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「一致、符合」，多用于固定短语。

entries.definition: In a way that follows from what has been said.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「因此；相应地」。

entries.definition: In agreement with something, matching it.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「一致的、协调的」。

entries.definition: A folding musical instrument with reeds.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「手风琴」，拼写相近但来源不同。

entries.definition: An arrangement or state in which people accept the same position.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「协议；同意」，指各方接受同一立场。

entries.definition: A formally written agreement between states.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「条约」，指国家之间的正式书面协议。

entries.definition: A pleasing fit between parts, or agreement of feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「和谐」，指各部分契合或情感一致。

entries.definition: A short, firm agreement between two sides.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「约定、协定」，指双方简短而明确的协议。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real heart root and the phrases the word actually forms.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子用的是这个词真实的「心」词根，以及它实际组成的短语。

normal.en: The word hides cor, Latin for heart, so an accord is hearts placed together.
normal.cn: 这个词里藏着 cor，即拉丁语的「心」，所以 accord 就是把心放到一起。

normal.en: Of one's own accord adds own and your, which is exactly the point: no outside push.
normal.cn: of one's own accord 里有 own 一词，正好点出关键：没有外力推动。

normal.en: The verb keeps a formal object: accord someone respect, permission, or a degree.
normal.cn: 动词多接正式宾语：给予尊重、给予许可，或授予学位。

normal.en: Accord with and in accord with both take with, because matching always needs a second thing.
normal.cn: accord with 与 in accord with 都带 with，因为「相符」总要有另一个对象。

normal.en: The musical sense is literal: voices sing in accord when they agree on one pitch.
normal.cn: 音乐义是字面的：嗓音在同一音高上一致，就是唱得和谐。

abstract.en: See two hands reach the middle of a table and rest on the same sheet of paper.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手伸到长桌中央，落在同一张纸上。

abstract.en: Two tuning forks sound and their waves line up exactly.
abstract.cn: 两只音叉同时发声，波形严丝合缝地对齐。

abstract.en: A heart moves forward before anyone touches it.
abstract.cn: 一颗心在还没有人碰它之前，就自己向前走了。

examples.en: The leaders signed an accord on climate funding.
examples.cn: 各国领导人签署了一项气候资金协议。

examples.en: His story does not accord with the evidence.
examples.cn: 他的说法与证据不符。

examples.en: She offered to help of her own accord.
examples.cn: 她主动提出要帮忙。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿扣的」——阿扣把两颗心扣到一起，就有了协议

root: 古法语 acorder「使同心」，源自拉丁语短语 ad cor「向着心」，词根 cor 意为「心」；十二世纪进入英语，最初作动词表示「使和解」，后引申出「协议」与「和音」。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses cover an agreement, a state of agreement, the granting of something, and correspondence with a fact.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项覆盖协议、一致的状态、给予某物，以及与事实相符。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hearts move to the same place and beat together.
core.cn: 核心意象：两颗心移到同一个位置，一起跳动。

branches.en: THE PACT: two sides settle terms.
branches.cn: 协议线：双方定下条件。

branches.en: THE HARMONY: opinions or facts agree.
branches.cn: 一致线：意见或事实相合。

branches.en: THE GRANT: something is given, often formally.
branches.cn: 授予线：某物被给出，常带正式意味。

branches.en: THE MATCH: one thing corresponds to another.
branches.cn: 相符线：一物与另一物对应。

branches.en: THE ONE MIND: a pact is agreement made visible.
branches.cn: 合意线：协议是让「一致」变得可见。

intro.en: The word is a Latin phrase compressed into one verb, so its parts are a preposition, the word for heart, and a French ending.
intro.cn: 这个词是一个拉丁短语压成一个动词，因此它的构件是一个介词、表示「心」的词，以及一个法语词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin cor and the phrase ad cor are attested; French acorder and the English noun are recorded from the twelfth century.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cor 与短语 ad cor 均有文献可证；法语 acorder 与英语名词自十二世纪起有记录。

items.example: It shows the hearts moving toward one point.
items.exampleCN: 它显示两颗心正朝同一个点移动。

items.example: It is the deepest root of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 它是整个词族最深的词根。

items.meaning: to reconcile, bring to one mind
items.example: It is the direct source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: 它是英语这个词的直接来源。

items.example: It entered English in the twelfth century.
items.exampleCN: 它在十二世纪进入英语。

items.example: It forms accordance.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accordance。

items.example: It forms according.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 according。

items.example: It forms accordingly.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accordingly。

items.example: It forms accordant.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accordant。

items.example: It shares the heart root with a different prefix.
items.exampleCN: 它与本词共享「心」词根，只是前缀不同。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ance 构成，义为「一致；符合」
由 according 加 -ly 构成，义为「因此；相应地」
由本词加 -ant 构成，义为「一致的；协调的」

definition_zh: 一致；符合；依照；和谐
definition_en: the state of agreeing with a rule, fact, or statement, used chiefly in the phrase in accordance with
core_image: 两样东西被摆成同一条线，边缘完全对齐
scene: 工程师把图纸铺在桌上，把新方案逐条与安全规范对照，确认每一处都吻合才签字。The building was approved in accordance with the new safety rules.
sceneCN: 这里 accordance 出现在固定短语 in accordance with 中（第 1 个义项：依照）；句意为这座建筑是依照新的安全规范获批的。

derivatives.zh: 本词的词干，义为「协议；给予」
由 according 加 -ly 构成，义为「因此；相应地」
由 accord 加 -ant 构成，义为「一致的；协调的」

senses.title: As required by a rule
senses.definition: in the phrase in accordance with, following what a rule, law, or instruction requires
senses.definitionCN: 在短语 in accordance with 中，指按照规则、法律或指示所要求的去做
senses.example: The samples were collected in accordance with the official method.
senses.exampleCN: 样本是依照官方方法采集的。
senses.why: Two lines laid on the same track is the physical picture of following a rule exactly.
senses.whyCN: 两条线铺在同一条轨道上，正是「完全照规则走」的实体画面。

senses.title: Agreement with the facts
senses.definition: the condition of a statement being true to what actually happened
senses.definitionCN: 某项陈述与实际发生之事相符的状态
senses.example: The report was checked for accordance with the recorded events.
senses.exampleCN: 报告经过核对，确认与记录的事件相符。
senses.why: Truth here is measured as fit, as if a copy were laid over the original.
senses.whyCN: 这里的「真」被当作「契合」来量，就像把副本覆在原件上。

senses.title: A shared opinion
senses.definition: the state in which people hold the same view on a matter
senses.definitionCN: 人们在一件事上持相同看法的状态
senses.example: There was full accordance among the members on the budget.
senses.exampleCN: 成员们在预算问题上完全一致。
senses.why: The noun is the settled form of the hearts that the verb brings together.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词是动词把心聚到一起之后定下来的形态。

intro.en: Accordance is the noun made from accord, and it survives almost entirely inside one fixed phrase.
intro.cn: accordance 是由 accord 构成的名词，如今几乎只活在一个固定短语里。

items.en: Outside the phrase in accordance with the noun is rare, and its older giving sense has died out.
items.cn: 除了 in accordance with 这个短语之外，这个名词很少单独使用，它较早的「给予」义也已消失。

items.en: The noun appeared in the fourteenth century as a general word for agreement or harmony.
items.cn: 这个名词在十四世纪出现，泛指一致或和谐。

items.en: The French form carried the same sense of things being brought into one line.
items.cn: 法语形式同样表示事物被摆到同一条线上。

items.en: It was built on acorder, the verb that also gave English accord.
items.cn: 它由动词 acorder 构成，而这个词也正是英语 accord 的来源。

items.en: The heart phrase underneath still explains why agreement is pictured as two hearts in one place.
items.cn: 底下那个关于心的拉丁短语，仍解释着为什么「一致」被画成两颗心在同一个地方。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the other forms of the same family; the near-meaning group gathers nouns for conformity.
note.cn: 形近组收同一词族的其他形式；近义组收表示符合、遵从的名词。

entries.definition: An agreement, or to grant something formally.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「协议」或「正式给予」。

entries.definition: Therefore, or in a matching manner.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「因此；相应地」。

entries.definition: In agreement with something.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「一致的、相符的」。

entries.definition: A folding instrument with reeds and keys.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「手风琴」，形近而源流不同。

entries.definition: Behaviour that matches an accepted rule or standard.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「符合、遵从」，指行为合乎既定规则。

entries.definition: The act of obeying a rule, order, or request.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「遵从、合规」，指服从规则、命令或要求。

entries.definition: A state in which people or things do not conflict.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「一致、同意」，指人或事不冲突的状态。

entries.definition: A pleasing correspondence among parts.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「和谐」，指各部分悦耳的对应。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the fixed phrase in view, because that is where the word now lives.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子始终盯着那个固定短语，因为这个词如今就住在里面。

normal.en: The word almost never travels alone: learn in accordance with as one block.
normal.cn: 这个词几乎从不单独出行，要把 in accordance with 当成一整块来记。

normal.en: Accordance is accord plus ance, and ance names a state, so it is the state of being in accord.
normal.cn: accordance 是 accord 加 ance，而 ance 表示状态，所以它就是「处于一致」的状态。

normal.en: The phrase takes with, not to, because correspondence needs a second object beside it.
normal.cn: 这个短语用 with 而不用 to，因为「对应」需要旁边有另一个对象。

normal.en: Keep accord, accordance and accordingly in one row; only the ending changes the job.
normal.cn: 把 accord、accordance、accordingly 排成一行，只有词尾改变它们的职务。

normal.en: In legal writing accordance with the law is a single formula and is never shortened.
normal.cn: 在法律文书里，accordance with the law 是一个完整格式，不会被缩短。

abstract.en: Two rulers are laid on a desk, and their edges meet without a gap.
abstract.cn: 两把直尺摆在桌上，边缘相接而没有缝隙。

abstract.en: A copy is placed over an original, and every line falls on the same line.
abstract.cn: 一张副本覆在原件上，每一道线都落在同一道线上。

abstract.en: A command and the deed that follows it move like two dancers on one beat.
abstract.cn: 一道命令与随之而来的行动，像两个舞者踩在同一个拍子上。

examples.en: All procedures were carried out in accordance with the guidelines.
examples.cn: 所有程序都是依照指南执行的。

examples.en: The payment was made in accordance with the contract.
examples.cn: 款项是依照合同支付的。

examples.en: The court ruled in accordance with previous decisions.
examples.cn: 法庭依照先前的判例作出了裁决。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿扣单死」——阿扣把单据扣死在一处，就是完全符合

root: 由 accord 加名词后缀 -ance 构成，而 accord 出自古法语 acorder「使同心」，再上溯到拉丁语短语 ad cor「向着心」，词根 cor 意为「心」；十四世纪进入英语，今多用于固定短语 in accordance with。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses cover conformity to a rule, correspondence with facts, and agreement between opinions.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项覆盖依照规定、与事实吻合，以及意见之间的一致。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two edges are laid together until no gap remains.
core.cn: 核心意象：两条边缘被并到一起，直到没有缝隙。

branches.en: THE RULE: action follows a stated standard.
branches.cn: 依照线：行为遵循既定的标准。

branches.en: THE FACT: a claim matches what happened.
branches.cn: 吻合线：说法与发生的事相符。

branches.en: THE OPINION: two views hold together.
branches.cn: 一致线：两种看法彼此相合。

branches.en: THE CONFORMITY: following a rule and holding with others are one kind of fitting.
branches.cn: 遵行线：遵循规则与同他人一致，是同一种「合」。

branches.en: THE AGREEMENT: facts and opinions are both things that can agree.
branches.cn: 相合线：事实与意见都是能够「相合」的东西。

intro.en: The noun is accord plus a state suffix, and the whole family rests on a Latin word for heart.
intro.cn: 这个名词是 accord 加一个表示状态的后缀，整个词族都靠着拉丁语里表示「心」的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin cor and ad cor are attested; the French noun and the English form are recorded from the fourteenth century.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cor 与 ad cor 均有文献可证；法语名词与英语形式自十四世纪起有记录。

items.example: It supplies the whole meaning of the noun.
items.exampleCN: 它为这个名词提供了全部意义。

items.example: It turns the base word into a noun of state.
items.exampleCN: 它把词干变成表示状态的名词。

items.example: It explains the original picture of two hearts.
items.exampleCN: 它解释了「两颗心」这一原始画面。

items.example: It marks the movement toward one point.
items.exampleCN: 它标出朝同一个点移动的方向。

items.example: It is the source of accord and accordance.
items.exampleCN: 它是 accord 与 accordance 的来源。

items.example: It appears in according to and accordingly.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 according to 与 accordingly 之中。

items.example: It adds the adverb ending to according.
items.exampleCN: 它给 according 加上副词词尾。

items.example: It adds an adjective ending to accord.
items.exampleCN: 它给 accord 加上形容词词尾。

derivatives.zh: 本词的词干，义为「协议；给予」
由 according 加 -ly 构成，义为「因此；相应地」

definition_zh: 因此；所以；相应地；照着
definition_en: in a way that follows from what has just been said, or in a matching manner
core_image: 前一句话落下，后一个动作就按那条线接了上去
scene: 天气预报说午后有暴雨，工头看了看天色，把下午的浇筑全部往后推。The forecast warned of heavy rain, and the crew planned accordingly.
sceneCN: 这里 accordingly 指依照前述情况作相应安排（第 2 个义项：相应地）；句意为预报提示有暴雨，施工队据此作了安排。

derivatives.zh: 本词的词干，义为「协议；给予」
由 accord 加 -ance 构成，义为「一致；符合」
由 accord 加 -ant 构成，义为「一致的；协调的」

senses.title: As a result of what was said
senses.definition: used to introduce a result that follows logically from the previous statement
senses.definitionCN: 用于引出由前一句逻辑推得的结果
senses.example: The road was flooded, and accordingly the match was cancelled.
senses.exampleCN: 道路被淹，比赛因此取消。
senses.why: The word marks a step that follows the previous one, like a second line drawn after the first.
senses.whyCN: 这个词标出一个跟着前一步走的动作，就像在第一道线之后再画一道线。

senses.title: In a matching way
senses.definition: in the manner that corresponds to a stated fact or plan
senses.definitionCN: 以与所述事实或计划相对应的方式
senses.example: The numbers changed, and the budget was revised accordingly.
senses.exampleCN: 数字变了，预算也相应作了修订。
senses.why: Here the adverb does not merely follow in time but matches in shape.
senses.whyCN: 这里的副词不仅在时间上跟着，还在形态上对应。

senses.title: As the situation requires
senses.definition: in whatever way the circumstances demand, without a fixed rule
senses.definitionCN: 按情形的需要而行，没有固定规则
senses.example: Each case is different, so each is handled accordingly.
senses.exampleCN: 每个案子都不同，所以各自酌情处理。
senses.why: The line to follow is drawn by the situation itself, not by a written order.
senses.whyCN: 要贴着走的那条线由情形本身画出，而不是由书面命令规定。

intro.en: Accordingly is accord plus an English participle and adverb ending, and its work is to make one statement follow another.
intro.cn: accordingly 是 accord 加上英语的分词与副词词尾，它的职责是让一句话跟着另一句话走。

items.en: Today the word is a connector, common in formal writing and in reports of decisions.
items.cn: 今天这个词是连接词，常见于正式文字与决策报告中。

items.en: The adverb appeared in the fifteenth century with the sense of in agreement with something.
items.cn: 这个副词在十五世纪出现，意为「与某物一致」。

items.en: According first meant corresponding, and the phrase according to still carries that sense.
items.cn: according 最初意为「相符的」，短语 according to 至今仍带这层意思。

items.en: The French verb meant to bring to one mind, and it is the source of the whole family.
items.cn: 那个法语动词意为「使同心」，是整个词族的来源。

items.en: Behind it stands the phrase to the heart, which pictures agreement as two hearts in one place.
items.cn: 它背后是「向着心」这个短语，把一致画成两颗心在同一个地方。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the other members of the family; the near-meaning group gathers connectors with similar force.
note.cn: 形近组收同一词族的其他成员；近义组收语气相近的连接词。

entries.definition: Corresponding, as in the phrase according to.
entries.definitionCN: 分词，义为「相符的」，见于短语 according to。

entries.definition: The state of agreeing with a rule or statement.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「一致、符合」。

entries.definition: In agreement, matching something.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「一致的、相符的」。

entries.definition: An agreement, or to grant formally.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「协议」或「正式给予」。

entries.definition: For that reason, introducing a conclusion.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「因此」，用于引出结论。

entries.definition: As a result, often of something bad or serious.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「结果、因此」，常用于不好的后果。

entries.definition: In a way that matches another change.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「相应地」，指与另一变化相配。

entries.definition: In a fitting or proper manner.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「适当地、得体地」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the visible pieces of the word and the frames it usually sits in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子用的是这个词看得见的构件，以及它常处的句式。

normal.en: See according inside it: accordingly means in a way that accords with what came before.
normal.cn: 里面看得见 according：accordingly 就是「按前面所说的方式」。

normal.en: The ending ly is the adverb flag, so the word always modifies an action or a whole sentence.
normal.cn: 词尾 ly 是副词的旗子，所以这个词总是修饰动作或整个句子。

normal.en: It usually follows a fact and introduces a response: the road flooded, and accordingly the match was cancelled.
normal.cn: 它常跟在事实之后引出反应：路被淹了，比赛因此取消。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with according to, which names a source rather than a result.
normal.cn: 不要与 according to 混淆，后者指出来源，而不是结果。

normal.en: In business writing accordingly often replaces therefore and sounds less abrupt.
normal.cn: 在商务文书里，accordingly 常替代 therefore，语气没有那么生硬。

abstract.en: One domino falls and the next one leans into the empty space it leaves.
abstract.cn: 一张骨牌倒下，下一张就倾进它让出的空位。

abstract.en: A train follows the rails laid just before it.
abstract.cn: 列车沿着刚刚铺好的轨道前行。

abstract.en: A sentence ends and the next action begins exactly where the full stop was.
abstract.cn: 一句话结束，下一个动作就从那个句号的位置开始。

examples.en: The deadline was moved, and the whole schedule changed accordingly.
examples.cn: 截止日期改了，整个日程也相应变动。

examples.en: He was told the rules and acted accordingly.
examples.cn: 他被告知了规则，并照此行事。

examples.en: Costs rose sharply; accordingly, the fee was increased.
examples.cn: 成本大幅上涨，费用因此提高。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额靠定哩」——靠前面那句话定下来，后面就照着做

root: 由 according 加副词后缀 -ly 构成；according 出自 accord，而 accord 来自古法语 acorder「使同心」，再上溯到拉丁语短语 ad cor「向着心」，词根 cor 意为「心」；副词形式自十五世纪起有记录。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses link a conclusion to what precedes it, match an action to a situation, and leave the degree to judgement.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项把结论与前述内容接上、让行动与情况相称，并把程度交给判断。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a second line is drawn exactly on top of the first.
core.cn: 核心意象：第二道线正好画在第一道线上面。

branches.en: THE CAUSE: what was said leads to a conclusion.
branches.cn: 因果线：前面所说的引出结论。

branches.en: THE MATCH: an action is shaped to fit the situation.
branches.cn: 对应线：行动按情况调整。

branches.en: THE JUDGEMENT: the degree is left to the actor.
branches.cn: 酌情线：程度交给行动者判断。

branches.en: THE FOLLOWING: conclusion and adjustment both follow from a stated fact.
branches.cn: 推论线：结论与调整都从已说的事实推出来。

branches.en: THE MEASURE: fitting an action includes deciding how much of it.
branches.cn: 调节线：让行动相称，也包括决定做多少。

intro.en: The adverb is built from the accord family with a participle and an adverb ending, so every part is still readable.
intro.cn: 这个副词由 accord 词族加上分词词尾与副词词尾构成，每个构件都还看得清。

latinIntro.en: Latin cor and ad cor are attested; the English adverb accordingly is recorded from the fifteenth century.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cor 与 ad cor 均有文献可证；英语副词 accordingly 自十五世纪起有记录。

items.example: It carries the core meaning of the family.
items.exampleCN: 它承载整个词族的核心意义。

items.example: It forms according, meaning corresponding.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 according，意为「相符的」。

items.example: It turns according into an adverb.
items.exampleCN: 它把 according 变成副词。

items.example: It is the deepest root of the family.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个词族最深的词根。

items.example: It marks the movement toward one point.
items.exampleCN: 它标出朝同一点移动的方向。

items.example: It is the source of accord.
items.exampleCN: 它是 accord 的来源。

items.example: It lives inside one fixed phrase.
items.exampleCN: 它几乎只活在一个固定短语里。

items.example: It describes things that fit together.
items.exampleCN: 它形容彼此契合的事物。
